issues.legal_issue: Compensation for similar nearby lands acquired at the same time for the same purpose must not differ without a strong basis for distinction.
material_facts: Land was acquired for resettlement of displaced families, and the appellants’ land was acquired at about the same time as land in nearby areas for the same purpose.
The acquired lands were adjacent or close to one another and were found to be similar.
Landowners in other references concerning comparable acquired land were awarded compensation of Rs.4,00,000 per Kanal, while the appellants were awarded Rs.2,50,000 per Kanal.
The appellants presented witness evidence and a sale deed relating to a small parcel in the vicinity to support their claim that the lower valuation was inadequate.
issues.conclusion: The Court set aside the High Court’s judgments and held that the appellants were entitled to compensation at Rs.4,00,000 per Kanal, with 15% solatium and other statutory benefits, on a par with the other landowners.
issues.legal_principle: Where land is acquired at the same time for the same purpose and the lands are identical or similar and situated nearby, landowners should not be paid different compensation without strong reasons. Comparable lands may be used as a comparative unit for determining market value. The Court relied on Union of India v. Bal Ram, (2010) 5 SCC 747, and Union of India v. Harinder Pal Singh, (2005) 12 SCC 564. The acquisition in this case was made under Section 4(1) of the Jammu and Kashmir Land Acquisition Act.

rule.if: land_acquisition_compensation_appeal and acquisitions_same_period and acquisitions_same_purpose and lands_similar and lands_nearby and comparable_landowners_received_higher_compensation

predicates.land_acquisition_compensation_appeal: The proceeding was an appeal concerning the amount of compensation payable for acquired land.
predicates.acquisitions_same_period: The land in the proceeding and comparable land were acquired at about the same time.
predicates.acquisitions_same_purpose: The land in the proceeding and comparable land were acquired for the same purpose.
predicates.lands_similar: The acquired lands were found to be identical or similar in relevant respects.
predicates.lands_nearby: The acquired lands were situated near or adjacent to one another.
predicates.comparable_landowners_received_higher_co: Landowners whose land was considered comparable received higher compensation in other proceedings.

issues.definition: When a compensation appeal concerns land acquired at about the same time and for the same purpose as nearby, similar land for which other landowners received higher compensation, the acquired landowners are entitled to parity in compensation.
